hypothesis: The converged native five-state bare MCDHF baseline omits same-symmetry core-hole mixing. Adding the complete stated 4f13 6s5d and 4f13 6s6p CSF families in exactly the same saved orbital space can measure correlation-induced relative-energy shifts and character transfer without a radial-cutoff scan.

Hamiltonians: Dirac-Coulomb + complete static Gaunt and retardation Breit
fixed_conditions.solver: public Atomx ci_solve dense; public build_ci_matrix retained
fixed_conditions.QED_recoil_dynamic_Breit: not included in this isolated CV comparison
fixed_conditions.NIST: same original nominal 005 rows; uncertainties/isotope unresolved

state_binding.DC: Embed each signed bare five-state CI vector into the full 68-CSF basis; track within its exact (2J,parity) block by largest squared overlap. Retain the complete overlap distribution and all block roots.
state_binding.static_Breit: Complete one-to-one maximum-overlap assignment from DC to static CI vectors within exact symmetry blocks; retain bare-reference strongest-overlap alternative and any disagreement. Do not replace target identity with local-root zero.
state_binding.ambiguity_action: Retain candidates and complete-subspace data, flag ambiguous branch; do not certify a unique physical state or an experimental pass.
state_binding.ground: Find global minimum over all 68 roots and report its symmetry, complete family weights, and bare-state weights. Excitations from tracked 6s and from actual finite-model ground remain separate.
state_binding.moments: For each bare vector, report the full spectral measure, centroid and variance. Weighted-multiplet D/P centroids use degeneracy 2J+1; fine splittings retain upper/lower identity.

resource.preflight: integer pattern_m_counts per unique occupation pattern and J block before determinant/angular table construction

stopping: Stop preserving all failures if input/source identity, exact family counts, raw determinant cap, memory/time cap, or numeric gates fail. Ambiguous branch assignment remains diagnostic; no fitting, threshold change, or radial-cutoff change.
